title: Earmark: create a budget
description: A USDC budget with one lead, one approver and one payee. Add more people later with the other Earmark forms. The DAO funds it with "Earmark: fund a budget".

fields.name: lead
fields.label: Lead
fields.help: Reviews work and pays from the budget.

fields.name: lead_limit
fields.label: Lead pays at once up to
fields.help: Payments up to this need no approval. In USDC's smallest unit: 1 USDC = 1000000, 0.25 USDC = 250000.

fields.name: approver
fields.label: Approver
fields.help: Approves payments above the lead's limit. Must not be the lead.

fields.name: approval_limit
fields.label: One approval covers up to
fields.help: Above this, a payment becomes a normal DAO vote. Must be at least the lead's limit. In USDC's smallest unit: 1 USDC = 1000000, 0.25 USDC = 250000.

fields.name: monthly_cap
fields.label: Most it can pay in 30 days
fields.help: In USDC's smallest unit: 1 USDC = 1000000, 0.25 USDC = 250000.

fields.name: payee
fields.label: First payee
fields.help: Who can be paid. Add more later.

summary: Create Earmark budget "{{name}}": {{lead}} pays at once up to {{lead_limit}}, {{approver}} approves up to {{approval_limit}}, at most {{monthly_cap}} per 30 days (USDC base units)
